changelog: New GMGN-style mobile UI (v4): 5 bottom tabs — Discover, Trenches, Track, Traders, You. Every earlier feature is still there
Trenches = Just-launched (<5 min) list; New / New & Safe / Trending live in the same tab
Track: holdings + Auto Team + Scorecard + P&L + reports; per-coin Auto Team detail from here
You → “My bot”: command bot (Hindi/English/Hinglish), Grid/DCA/MA bots, Copy Trade; Traders: smart wallets + Copy Trade
New watchlist (⭐), Discover banners/entry cards, Buy/Sell bar at the bottom of the token page
Same reliable chart logic (multi-source race, SIMULATED fallback, status line, Retry); demo money only
New: source badges on every coin in Trenches/Trending (pump.fun, DexScreener, GeckoTerminal, Jupiter) + a source filter. X/Twitter trending is not available without a paid key — the app says so

New: give Auto Team a task in Hindi/English/Hinglish (e.g. “sirf pump.fun ke naye coins, mcap 100k-2M, 2% per trade, TP 20 SL 8”) — it shows what it understood, you edit + confirm, then it paper-buys matching coins now
New: demo funds — Add / Remove / Set with history (not counted as P&L). Every position shows Invested, Value now, P&L ($ and %), plus total invested and total P&L
Data migration v1.2.x → v1.3.0 (schema 5): balance, trades, bots, copy wallets, Auto Team all preserved; old version at /old/
